newsitem.title: USA: Compton, Calif., mayor seeks $200 mln school bond.
newsitem.headline: Compton, Calif., mayor seeks $200 mln school bond.

text.p: Compton, Calif.,'s mayor has vowed to seek a $200 million bond issue to improve local school facilities, according to a published report on Tuesday.
Mayor Omar Bradley told the Los Angeles Times that he would prod the city council to issue the bonds to replace one dilapidated high school and repair dozens of others.
Bradley said he hoped the bonds would also raise enough money to pay off Compton's $20 million debt to the state.
Compton school district officials said they were considering a much smaller general obligation bond issue, the Times reported.
Bradley was not immediately available for comment.
